title: Five Puck Scoring Race - Half Ice
description: A half-ice team scoring race. Five pucks are spaced along the blue line and players take turns attacking the net. A made shot allows the next player to go after the scorer reaches the blue line; a missed puck must be retrieved and reset before the next player starts.
coaching_points: Attack the net at game speed.
After a goal, skate hard back to the blue line to release the next teammate.
If the shot misses, retrieve and reset the puck before changing.
First team to score all five pucks wins.

title: Four Shot Half Ice Shooting Drill
description: A half-ice shooting sequence with four shots from different locations. Forwards work off the wall and through the slot while defensemen transition along the blue line and move the puck D-to-D for the final point shot.
coaching_points: Move the feet off the wall before shooting.
Use puck-protection turns along the boards.
Defensemen create lateral separation before receiving the D-to-D pass.
Stop at the net and create traffic for point shots.

title: Continuous 2 on 1 with Backchecker
description: A continuous full-ice 2-on-1 rush drill with a designated backchecker. The coach signals the transition side, the forwards react, the defense gaps up, and the F2-line forward backchecks the next rush.
coaching_points: Strong-side forward opens up quickly while weak-side support fills the opposite lane.
Defenseman retakes ice before defending the rush.
Backchecker communicates with the defender and identifies the weak-side threat.
Optionally activate the defenseman as a trailer to create a 3-on-2.

title: Neutral Zone Puck Skills #1
description: A three-part neutral-zone skill station combining large puck-control movements, puck protection along the wall, and quick-hands stickhandling through a tighter obstacle section.
coaching_points: Use both hands on the stick and cradle the puck around obstacles.
Stay balanced on the inside edges.
Use the body to protect the puck along the wall.
Finish with fast hands while maintaining posture and control.

title: Full Ice Skills Series - 1 Goalie
description: A full-ice one-goalie setup where players work a coach-selected skating or puck skill through five to six obstacles, pass to a coach, support through the slot for a return pass, then push the puck with one hand down ice before finishing with a shot.
coaching_points: Support the puck through the slot after the first pass.
Stay low with full extension and recovery on the forward stride.
Push the puck rather than over-stickhandling at speed.
Keep the puck close to the blade while using one hand.

title: The Greatest Drill in the World
description: A 3-on-3 cross-ice game with designated outlet players on both sides. The team in possession can use either outlet, creating a temporary numerical advantage and encouraging constant support, quick puck movement, and give-and-go play.
coaching_points: Move without the puck and stay available as an outlet.
Use the side support players to create 2-on-1 situations.
Communicate continuously.
Protect the puck until a high-value pass opens.

title: Neutral Zone Passing Station #1
description: A neutral-zone passing station that can run in three lanes. Partners pass between cone gates, switch sides at the far end with a drop pass, then continue back while alternating forehand and backhand receiving.
coaching_points: Give a clear target on every pass.
Use both forehand and backhand passing and receiving.
Drop the puck onto the partner's forehand when switching sides.
Switch sides each repetition to train both directions.

title: Five Puck Scoring Race
description: A full-ice team scoring relay. Five pucks are placed on each blue line and players leave the bench one at a time for breakaways. A missed puck must be recovered and reset before the next teammate can go.
coaching_points: Attack each breakaway at full speed.
After scoring, skate back to the blue line before the next player leaves.
If the puck is missed, retrieve and replace it before changing.
First team to score all five pucks wins.

title: Savy's Continuous Breakout Drill with Forecheckers
description: A continuous breakout drill with three designated forecheckers. The coach controls the pressure by releasing one, two, or all three forecheckers while the breakout unit retrieves and exits under pressure.
coaching_points: Breakout players shoulder-check before retrievals.
Communicate support options early.
Forecheckers pressure with structure instead of chasing the puck.
Vary the number of forecheckers to change difficulty.

title: 2-1 Low/2-1 Long
description: A two-stage 2-on-1 drill. Two forwards first handle a rim and attack low, then create traffic for a quick point shot before leaving the zone, receiving a new puck, and attacking the shooting defenseman on a long 2-on-1.
coaching_points: Handle the first rim cleanly and attack immediately.
Create traffic on the point shot before transitioning out.
Forwards get up ice quickly on the long 2-on-1.
Defenseman gaps up after the point shot and protects the middle.
